meta.parties: Ibrahim Neina v. Kosumma Et Al

rules.statement: A document signed by a deceased person, witnessed by a notary and two witnesses in the presence of each other, can be admitted to probate if there is sufficient evidence that the formalities were met.
rules.supporting_quote: "I have no doubt from the evidence on the record that the testator signed the deed in the presence of the notary and the two witnesses, who were all present together and conscious of the act being done in the sense required under the English Wills Act"
